messages.author: b4d525cf1ffc5453
messages.subject: Robust estimator error
parts:
I tried to fit a variety of models, while I allways got the same error message:

Error in eigen(VarCov, symmetric = TRUE, only.values = TRUE) : unendliche oder fehlende Werte in 'x'

To keep it simple I give a stupid example (more complex models with other variables end up with the same error):

model <- '
            level: 1
            PoKWsum~PrKWsum
           
            level: 2
            PoKWsum~PrKWsum
                        '
fit <- sem(model, MLC, cluster="ID_C", missing="fiml", estimator="MLR")

summary(fit, rsquare=TRUE, standardized=TRUE)

However, it seems that "fiml" and the robust estimater "MLR" do not  work with each other. The error no longer occurs when I omit "fiml" or "MLR".

Thank you! Maurus

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Robust estimator error
parts:
Unfortunately, missing = "ml" + estimator = "MLR" is not supported yet
in two-level models.

missing = "ml" is fairly new (0.6-9), and not quite 'complete': no
supoprt for MLR, no support for conditional.x, ...

(But a more elegant error message would be in order).

Yves.
